text.marquee: RANK UP CITY · BUILDING 5 · THE RADIO TOWER
text.tagline:
Say it on air. Catch the fast talkers.
Never leave dead air.
text.taglineEs: Habla al micrófono, entiende el habla rápida y no dejes silencios. Suma patitas <ico-paw></ico-paw> en cada ronda.
text.help: When you see a microphone, say the line out loud. If your browser can't listen, you record yourself, compare with the model and rate your take. Fast clips: play them and choose the full words. And watch the ON AIR meter: if it empties, that's dead air. Stuck? Enri's purr boost gives you a hint.
text.bossWin: And we're off air. Three minutes, live, and not one second of dead air. The Signal has its new voice, and you rank up to C2. The official C1 exam is waiting for you.
text.gameOver: Off air. It happens to the best of us. Take a breath and go live again.
text.deadAir: Dead air! The station went silent. Take a breath and go live again.
text.good: That sounded like radio. Roz is smiling, and Roz never smiles. Your prize is waiting. Claim it!
text.ok: A rough show. Every host has one. Run it back for a better card, or claim your prize anyway.

boss.name: THE ON AIR LIGHT
boss.quote: Red means live. Live means you.

common.name: PRESS PASS
common.quote: Testing, one, two. Run it back!

s1.name: Sound check
s1.tag: Idioms & collocations · say it out loud
s1.intro: Welcome to the Radio Tower. I own the station, and The Signal needs a new voice. In this building, you speak: when you see a microphone, say the line out loud. If your browser can't listen, you record yourself and rate your take. First, a sound check with Roz.

rounds.line: Mic check. Read the line on the card, nice and clear.
rounds.target: Testing, one, two. This is The Signal.
accept: Testing one two this is the signal
rounds.retryLine: Again, a bit closer to the mic.
rounds.thanks: Levels are good. You sound like radio.

rounds.line: Quick traffic update for the drivers: avoid the bridge, there's heavy ___.
rounds.retryLine: Which word goes with heavy on the roads?
rounds.thanks: Heavy traffic. That's a collocation, love. Keep them together.

rounds.line: Tell the listeners how this morning went. Use the line on the card.
rounds.target: We hit the ground running this morning.
rounds.retryLine: Once more, with energy. We hit the ground running.
rounds.thanks: And we did. Thanks, partner.

rounds.line: Morning, Signal! So, we'd nearly finished the plan, and then the client changed everything. Back to square one.
options: They had to start again from the beginning.
They moved to a new square.
rounds.retryLine: Back to square one, mate. Where's square one?
rounds.thanks: Exactly. All of it. From the start.

rounds.line: Last check. You're writing to the council about the night bus. Say the opening line.
rounds.target: I'd like to raise a concern.
accept: I would like to raise a concern
rounds.retryLine: Raise, not rise. Try it again.
rounds.thanks: Polite and firm. Sound check done.

s2.name: The morning show
s2.intro: The morning show. Link your ideas, and when you want a headline, turn the sentence around: never have I, not only did they. And never, ever leave dead air.

rounds.line: Give me the headline for the festival story.
rounds.target: Never have I seen such a crowd.
rounds.retryLine: Once more. Start with never.
rounds.thanks: That's a headline.

rounds.line: It rained all day. … thousands came.
rounds.note: Choose the link before the air runs out.
options: To cut a long story short,
rounds.retryLine: Dead air! Pick the contrast.
rounds.thanks: Even so, thousands came. Smooth.

rounds.line: Write me the second headline. They came, and then they stayed all night. Make it an inversion.
rounds.answer: Not only did they come but they stayed
alts: Not only did they come but they also stayed
rounds.retryLine: Not only, then did, then the subject.
rounds.thanks: Not only did they come, but they stayed. Print it.

rounds.line: Sorry, a caller cut in there. Take us back to the bridge story.
options: As I was saying, the bridge reopens on Monday.
rounds.retryLine: Dead air! Get us back on topic.
rounds.thanks: Back on track. Nice recovery.

rounds.line: Close the segment with a warning about the festival's last night.
rounds.target: Under no circumstances should you miss this.
rounds.retryLine: Under no circumstances, then should, then you.
rounds.thanks: Lovely. Rarely have I heard it said better.

s3.name: The call-in hour
s3.intro: The call-in hour. Callers talk fast: whaddaya, shoulda, gonna. Play each clip, catch the full words, and write the number down.

rounds.line: A caller, at full speed. What did she say?
rounds.clipText: Whaddaya wanna do about the night bus?
options: What do you want to do about the night bus?
What did you want to do about the night bus?
Where do you want to go on the night bus?
rounds.retryLine: Play it again. Listen to the first word.
rounds.thanks: That's it. Whaddaya is what do you.

rounds.line: Line two. He sounds sorry about something.
options: Sorry, I should have called earlier.
Sorry, I would have called earlier.
rounds.retryLine: Shoulda. Should what?
rounds.thanks: Should have. Got it.

rounds.line: Can she come to the panel on Thursday, or can't she?
rounds.clipText: I can't make it Thursday, sorry.
options: I can't make it Thursday, sorry.
I can make it Thursday, sorry.
I could make it Thursday, sorry.
rounds.retryLine: Listen to the vowel, not the T.
rounds.thanks: Right. A long, strong vowel means can't.

rounds.line: Shadow the caller. Say it the way people say it.
rounds.target: I'm gonna be there at eight.
accept: I'm going to be there at eight
I'm going to be there at 8
rounds.retryLine: Faster, and a bit lazier. Gonna.
rounds.thanks: Spot on. You sound like a local.

rounds.line: The prize winner left a number. Get it down!
rounds.clipText: Call me back on five five five, oh one two, nine eight seven three.
rounds.retryLine: Play it again. Write the digits as you hear them.
rounds.thanks: That's the one. I'll ring her back.

s4.name: The panel
s4.intro: The panel. The guests disagree, politely or not. Take the floor, concede a point, and soften the producer's notes. Stay on air.

rounds.line: And another thing about four-day weeks: my store is open six days, so…
rounds.note: You want to speak. Take the floor politely.
rounds.retryLine: Whoa. Ask, don't grab.
rounds.thanks: Sure. Go ahead.

rounds.line: Mm. Interesting idea. I'll bear it in mind.
rounds.note: What does Robin usually mean by that?
rounds.retryLine: Listen to the tone. Is that a yes?
rounds.thanks: You read me well.

rounds.line: A four-day week would make everyone happier. It's that simple.
options: That's a fair point, but it overlooks the cost.
That's a fair point, and so I disagree.
rounds.retryLine: Give me something first, then disagree.
rounds.thanks: Granted, the cost. Let's talk about it.

rounds.line: In your ear: the guest is talking way too fast. Tell him nicely.
options: You might want to slow down a little.
rounds.retryLine: Softer. He's our guest, remember.
rounds.thanks: Perfect. He didn't even notice.

rounds.line: Thirty seconds left. Close the panel.
rounds.target: We'll have to leave it there.
accept: We will have to leave it there
rounds.retryLine: Clearly, and with a smile. We'll have to leave it there.
rounds.thanks: And we're out. Lovely work.

sb.name: Live at nine
sb.tag: BOSS · one meter for the whole show
sb.intro: Live at nine. One broadcast, one ON AIR light, and one dead-air meter for the whole show. Open the show, take a caller, handle a guest, give the headline and close. A good answer buys back a little air. Do it, and you rank up to C2.

rounds.line: Red light's on. Open the show.
rounds.target: Good evening, and welcome to The Signal.
accept: Good evening and welcome to the signal
rounds.retryLine: Again! We're live!
rounds.thanks: We're on. Keep going.

rounds.line: First caller, and he's in a hurry.
rounds.clipText: Hey, it's Max. I'm gonna hafta call back later.
options: I am going to have to call back later.
I am going to call back later.
I had to call back later.
rounds.retryLine: Gonna hafta. Going to what?
rounds.thanks: Got it. He'll call back.

rounds.line: Frankly, cities should ban cars completely. Tomorrow.
options: That's a fair point, but it overlooks people who can't walk far.
Granted, and so I agree completely.
rounds.retryLine: Concede, then turn. Quickly!
rounds.thanks: A fair challenge. I'll allow it.

rounds.line: Give me the headline about tonight's guest. Rarely…
rounds.retryLine: After rarely, the auxiliary comes first.
rounds.thanks: Rarely have we had a guest so honest. Lovely.

rounds.line: Ten seconds. Close the show.
rounds.target: We'll have to leave it there. Good night.
accept: We will have to leave it there good night
rounds.retryLine: Close it! Now!
rounds.thanks: And we're off air.
